questions.question: In Six Days, Seven Nights, what is Harrison Ford’s rough-around-the-edges pilot named?
questions.note: Ford plays Quinn, a cargo pilot stranded with Anne Heche’s magazine editor after a crash.

questions.question: Which actor co-stars with Harrison Ford in Six Days, Seven Nights?
questions.note: Heche plays Robin Monroe, who is stranded with Ford’s pilot on a South Pacific island.

questions.question: In Random Hearts, what is Harrison Ford’s character named?
questions.note: Ford plays a police sergeant whose wife dies in a plane crash alongside another woman’s husband.

questions.question: Which actor co-stars with Ford in Random Hearts?
questions.note: Scott Thomas plays Kay Chandler, who investigates the apparent affair behind the crash with Ford’s Dutch.

questions.question: In Hollywood Homicide, what is Harrison Ford’s LAPD detective named?
questions.note: Gavilan moonlights as a real-estate agent while investigating a murder with his younger partner.

questions.question: Which actor plays Ford’s younger LAPD partner in Hollywood Homicide?
questions.note: Hartnett plays K.C. Calden in the 2003 buddy-cop film.

questions.question: In Firewall, what is Harrison Ford’s bank-security expert named?
questions.note: Stanfield is blackmailed into helping criminals steal from the bank he protects.

questions.question: In What Lies Beneath, which actor plays Ford’s wife, Claire Spencer?
questions.note: Pfeiffer plays Claire, who suspects their lakeside home is haunted.

questions.question: In Crossing Over, Harrison Ford plays an officer for which U.S. agency?
questions.note: Ford plays ICE agent Max Brogan in the Los Angeles-set immigration drama.

questions.question: In Extraordinary Measures, who does Harrison Ford play?
questions.note: Ford plays a researcher pursuing a treatment for Pompe disease.
